concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a high-end bespoke typographic identity concept board for a PERSONAL website, not a company. The owner is Maxime de Visscher, a creative technologist and UX architect. Exact mandatory full name: "Maxime de Visscher" (V-i-s-s-c-h-e-r). The owner rejected conventional bold typefaces, serif signatures, decorative stars and standalone monograms. He wants understated yet confident, with strong original typography, aligned with a website featuring a copper particle portrait forming from small triangular fragments against a deep aubergine-black ground. Design actual custom letterforms, not a stock font with an icon added. Keep the name instantly readable and the full surname prominent. Flat crisp vector-like artwork, no photography, no metallic material, no 3D mockups, no bevels, no gradients, no generic futuristic gamer typography, no brackets or code symbols, no sparkles. Palette: ground #20161d, lettering warm off-white #f0e4df, one restrained copper accent #e9aa98. Landscape board 1536x1024. Beautifully art-directed spacing. The upper 65% shows the large wordmark composition with plenty of negative space. A very thin rule separates the lower third showing a believable slim website header at actual reduced scale: small wordmark at left and simple navigation at right reading "About  Missions  Lab  Get in touch ↗". Include a small enlarged detail of the distinguishing letter construction near the lower edge, without diagrams or explanatory paragraphs. All lettering must be precisely spelled. The large and small wordmarks must be the SAME design. Do not let lettering become illegible. CONCEPT 01: FACETTES. Purpose-drawn contemporary humanist geometric lettering with restrained angular facets echoing the folded triangular portrait particles. Confident medium-weight strokes; generous open counters; beautifully balanced close spacing. Start from rounded, accessible lowercase rhythm, and introduce a consistent tiny diagonal wedge cut at only selected joins in M, x, V and r. The wedges are structural negative spaces in the letters, NOT triangles scattered around text. Capital M and capital V are recognizably related through their diagonal construction. Compose the full name as one confident typographic signature on two carefully balanced lines "Maxime" then "de Visscher". Both lines have comparable visual presence. Copper appears in just one small detached counter fragment of the x, the rest remains off-white. Sophisticated experimental Swiss/Dutch type design rather than science fiction. Tiny board label at top left "01 / FACETTES".

The LEFT STEM of the initial m is made of exactly three precisely aligned short solid modules, separated by thin horizontal negative gaps; all other strokes and all surname letters are solid and confident. As the eye moves left to right, the wordmark becomes continuous. The three stem modules subtly progress from dark copper to warm copper to off-white, a restrained discrete color sequence, no gradients, no flying dots, no texture. Lowercase letter proportions should be original: broad m shoulders, circular but open e, short compact r, round i dots. Crucially not a dot-matrix font, stencil military font or pixel font. The complete silhouette should be an elegant serious personal signature, with the concept only discovered on closer inspection. Tiny board label at top left "03 / ÉMERGENCE".

refinement: Remove glow, halo, bloom, haze, gradients and shadows. Preserve letter outlines, spelling and layout. Use flat aubergine background, off-white letters and copper accents.
